symbols.title: Target Tickers / Equities
symbols.description: List of tickers or optionable equities/indices to calculate full volatility diagnostics for (e.g. SPY, QQQ, AAPL, NVDA, TSLA, MSFT, AMZN).

includeSmileCurve.title: Include Volatility Smile & Skew Curve
includeSmileCurve.description: Calculate strike-by-strike Call and Put Implied Volatility curves across the nearest expiration.

includeTermStructure.title: Include Implied Volatility Term Structure
includeTermStructure.description: Calculate ATM IV term structure across all future expiration cycles and classify Contango vs Backwardation.

includeHistoricalVol.title: Include 1-Year Historical IV vs RV Series
includeHistoricalVol.description: Include daily 1-year history of 30-day Realized Volatility, VIX benchmark, and underlying price.

includeExpectedMoveCone.title: Include Expected Move Projections
includeExpectedMoveCone.description: Calculate market-implied upper and lower expected move bounds from ATM straddles across nearest 4 expiration cycles.

maxExpirationsToScan.title: Max Expirations to Scan
maxExpirationsToScan.description: Maximum number of forward expiration cycles to process in the term structure matrix.
